title: Ngā Kaitukino o te Hunga Whiriwhiri
intro: I roto i te hītori, i haereere ngā karere atua i waenganui i te tangata, ā, ko ētahi o te hunga tata ki a rātou kāore i kite i te māramatanga. E pā ana tēnei kōrero ki ngā wairua e rua, ko tō rāua tata ki te poropititanga i whakamātautau i a rāua, ā, ko tō rāua taonga tuku iho he akoranga mutunga kore.
clues: I ora tātou i ngā wā o ngā poropiti nunui, heoi i katia tonu ō tātou kanohi ki te pono i kawea mai e rātou.
I ī tonu ō mātou kāinga i te whakakitenga mai o te rangi, engari i whakapakeketia ō mātou ngākau.
I moe māua ki ngā tāne i whiriwhiria hei whakatūpato i ō rātou iwi.
I te taenga mai o te whiu, kāore mātou i rapu piringa i roto i te āaka, kāore hoki i rere i te ua mura, nā te mea i tawai mātou ki ngā whakatūpato.
Kua whakahuatia tātou i roto i te Quran hei tauira mō te hunga whakateka, e whakaatu ana ahakoa te whanaungatanga tata ki te poropiti, kāore e whakaora.
Ko mātou ngā wāhine a Noa rāua ko Ruta, nā rāua rāua i tinihanga, ā, nā reira i whakataua ai rāua.

identity.label: Ko wai tātou?
options: Ngā wāhine a Noa rāua ko Ruta
Ngā wāhine a Ibrahim rāua ko Ihimaera
Ngā wāhine a Mohi rāua ko Hārana
Ngā wāhine a Rawiri rāua ko Hurama
Ngā wāhine a Ayyub rāua ko Yunus
identity.answer: Ngā wāhine a Noa rāua ko Ruta

trial.label: He aha te whakawakanga i mahia ki a rātou?
options: I marena rātou ki ngā poropiti, engari kāore i whakapono
He pakoko rātou, ā, i whakapae rātou i ngā poropiti
He whai rawa rātou, he whakakake hoki
I whakamatautauria rātou e Iblis kia wehe atu i ō rātou kāinga
I karakia rātou ki te Kuao Kau Koura
trial.answer: I marena rātou ki ngā poropiti, engari kāore i whakapono

location.label: I aha te hononga o tō rātou aituā?
options: Te waipuke me te ua o ngā kōhatu
He hau kaha
He rū whenua
Te mate urutā o ngā mawhitiwhiti
Te wehenga o te moana
location.answer: Te waipuke me te ua o ngā kōhatu

outcome.label: He aha tō rātou mutunga?
options: I mate tahi rātou me te hunga whakaponokore
I ripeneta rātou, ā, i whakaorangia
I mahue kore tamariki rātou
I peia atu rātou ake ake
I hurihia rātou hei makimaki me hei poaka
outcome.answer: I mate tahi rātou me te hunga whakaponokore

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
